extension.description: Jump between generated Go code and source .proto definitions, with Proto-to-Go usage search and project compile rules.
configuration.title: JumpProto
configuration.protoRoots.description: Fallback directories that contain your source .proto files when the opened project's .jumpproto does not define protoRoots.
configuration.uiLanguage.description: UI language for JumpProto view and messages.
configuration.searchInWorkspace.descript: Fallback setting for whether to search proto files inside the current workspace when the opened project's .jumpproto does not define searchInWorkspace.
configuration.makeProtoCommand.descripti: Fallback shell command template used to compile the current .proto file when the opened project's .jumpproto does not define makeProtoCommand. Supported placeholders: {workspaceFolder}, {protoSrcRoot}, {protoFile}, {protoFileNoExt}, {protoDir}, {relativeProto}, {relativeProtoNoExt}, {protoPackage}.
configuration.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from JumpProto workspace searches. Use this to skip generated, vendor, build, or large directories.
